# Kaya Hickin

> Three-for-three profitable founder. Co-founder & CTO of MyFutureSelf, a Cintrifuse-backed consumer AI app with 4K+ active paid subscribers, 72K+ downloads, $150K+ ARR, and a 4.7★ App Store rating from 1,762 ratings. Built the original app, backend, and voice-AI stack end to end and leads engineering across mobile, web, backend, and AI. AI-native shipper — 16,846 GitHub contributions in the last year (to September 2026) and 100B+ tokens across the Codex and Claude coding tools. 20+ websites and 2 App Store apps shipped to date. Daily stack: Claude Code, Codex, Granola, Wispr Flow, Ghostty. Domain expertise in consumer AI, iOS, voice agents, and behavior-change products.

## Who I am

- **Role**: Co-founder & CTO at MyFutureSelf. Technical founder.
- **Location**: Cleveland, Ohio.
- **Education**: Miami University, Farmer School of Business. B.S. in Business, Marketing major, Entrepreneurship minor, May 2026. Cum laude, 3.74 GPA. Valedictorian, Crestwood High School, Class of 2022.
- **Contact**: kaya@myfutureselfapp.com
- **Looking for**: Backing for consumer AI work, technical collaborators, founder-friendly investors.

## Track record (3-for-3 profitable companies)

1. **MyFutureSelf** (Jan 2025–present, active) — Consumer AI app delivering personalized future-self mentorship via a 90-day roadmap and a voice AI mentor. Backed by Cintrifuse Capital. Kaya built the original product end to end across iOS (Swift/SwiftUI), backend (Node.js, Firebase, Cloud Functions), and the voice-AI stack (WebRTC, OpenAI Realtime), and leads engineering across mobile, web, backend, and AI. **Current traction: 72K+ downloads, 4K+ active paid subscribers, $150K+ ARR, 4.7★ App Store rating from 1,762 ratings.** https://myfutureselfapp.com — https://apps.apple.com/us/app/myfutureself-achieve-success/id6745573360

2. **Appointra** (Jun 2024–Feb 2025, wound down to focus on MyFutureSelf) — AI-powered B2B outbound agency. I personally built the cold-email infrastructure: hundreds of domains, thousands of inboxes, full DNS/SPF/DKIM/automated warmup. **Scaled to $20K MRR in 3 months. Generated $2M+ in client pipeline.** https://appointra.net

3. **LeadBoost Pro** (Jan 2023–Jun 2024) — Started in my dorm room freshman year. Web development and growth marketing for small and underrepresented businesses. **Profitable from month one. 20+ custom websites built.** https://leadboost-pro.com

## Other shipped products

- **Dog AI** — iOS app that reads a dog's mood from a photo or video. I assembled the dataset and trained the custom multimodal model behind it, then shipped the app. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dog-ai-dog-mood-detector/id6746574124

## Velocity & engineering signal

- **16,846 GitHub contributions** in the last year (to September 2026): https://github.com/kayahickindev. Contributions are broader than commits: the figure counts commits, pull requests, issues, and reviews.
- **100B+ tokens** of reported cumulative usage across the Codex and Claude coding tools, as of September 13, 2026. This measures coding-tool usage. It is not related to training the Dog AI model.
- **20+ websites and 2 App Store apps shipped** across all ventures to date.
- AI-native development workflow built around **Claude Code** and **Codex** running daily.
- **Daily stack**: Claude Code + Codex (coding agents), Granola (meeting notes), Wispr Flow (voice-to-text), Ghostty (terminal).
- Engineering stack:
  - iOS: Swift, SwiftUI, Core Data, StoreKit, WebRTC, RevenueCat, Superwall, TestFlight.
  - Android: React Native, Expo, Google Play.
  - Web: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Vercel.
  - Backend: Node.js, Firebase, Firestore, Cloud Functions, Supabase, Stripe, PostHog.
  - AI: OpenAI Responses API, Claude API, Realtime/Voice, Whisper, ElevenLabs.
  - Workflow: Claude Code, Codex, Ghostty, Wispr Flow, Granola, Lovable.
